a: Ema sefa, amru lo lerabbi eliezer: im matbilin keli tame littaher, yatbilu keli lichsheyyitma littaher? shema minna chayylin.

Amri: rabbanan la kayymi lehon betameh derabbi eliezer, vehachi kaamri leh: may sevira lach? i sevira lach dechayylin uvatlin — tihve keli teyuvetach, i la sevira lach dechayylin — tihve mikve teyuvetach.
Ta shema, amar lahem rabbi eliezer: uma zeraim temeim, kevan shezzeraan bekarka tehorin, zeruin veomdim — lo kol shekken? shema minna la chayylin.
Verabbanan la darshi kal vachomer? veha tanya: yachol yimkor adam et bitto keshehi naara? amrat kal vachomer: mechura kevar — yotza, enah mechura — eno din shello timmacher?
b: In, bealma darshi kal vachomer, veshane hacha deamar kera "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu". et shebba lichlal hakem — ba lichlal hafer, et shello ba lichlal hakem — lo ba lichlal hafer.
Mishna hafarat nedarim kol hayyom. yesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir
Ketzad? nadra belele shabbat — yafer belele shabbat uveyom hashshabbat ad shettechshach. nadra im chashecha — mefer ad shello techshach, sheim chashcha velo hefer — eno yachol lehafer,
Gemara tanya: hafarat nedarim kol hayyom. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru: meet leet. may tama detanna kamma, amar kera: "beyom shomo".
Verabbanan may tamayyhu — dichtiv: "miyyom el yom".
Uletanna kamma, ha ketiv "miyyom el yom"! itzterich. dei "beyom shomo", hava amena bimama — in, belelya — la, ketiv "miyyom el yom".
Uleman deamar "miyyom el yom", ha ketiv "beyom shomo"! itzterich, dei ketiv "miyyom el yom", hava amena mechad beshabba lechad beshabba lefar lah, ketiv "beyom shomo".
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en halacha keoto hazzug. levi savar lemibad kehane tannae. amar leh rav, hachi amar chavivi: en halacha keoto hazzug.
Chiyyay bar rav shade gira uvadek. rabba bar rav huna yatev vekaem.

a: Tenan hatam: mefirin nedarim beshabbat, venishalin lindarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat. ibbaya lehu: mefirin nedarim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat, o dilma afillu shello letzorech?

Ta shema, detane rav zute deve rav pappe: en mefirin nedarim ella letzorech hashshabbat. amar rav ashe, ha la tenan hachi: nadra im chashecha — mefer lah ad shello techshach. vei amrat letzorech hashshabbat — in, shello letzorech hashshabbat — la, may irya chashcha? afillu betoch hayyom eno yachol lehafer deshello letzorech!
Tannae hi: hafarat nedarim kol hayyom, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru: meet leet.
Leman deamar kol hayyom in, tefe la — afillu shello letzorech hashshabbat mefer. leman deamar meet leet, letzorech hashshabbat — in, shello letzorech hashshabbat — la.

Venishalin lindarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat. ibbaya lehu: keshello haya lahem penay, o dilma keshehaya lahem penay? ta shema, deizdekiku leh rabbanan livreh derav zutera bereh derav zeera afillu bindarim shehaya lahem penay mibbeod yom.
Savar rav yosef lememar: nishalin nedarim beshabbat, beyachid mumeche — in, bishlosha hedyotot — la, mishshum demitchaze kedina.
Amar leh abbaye: kevan disvira lan afillu meummad, afillu bikrovim, vaafillu ballayla — la mitchaze kedina.
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: halacha, mefirin nedarim ballayla. veha matnitin hi: nadra belele shabbat! ella ema: halacha, nishalin ballayla.
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav huna: amar rav hachi? amar leh: ishtik. amar leh: ishtik ka amrat, o shate kaamrat?
Amar rav ika bar avin: izdekik leh rav lerabba
b: Bekitona deve rav, omed, yechidi, uvallayla.
Amar rabba amar rav nachman: halacha, nishalin nedarim omed, yechidi, uvallayla, uvashshabbat, uvikrovim, vaafillu haya lahen penay mibbeod yom.

Omed? vehatanya: yarad rabban gamliel min hachamor venitattef veyashav vehittir lo nidro. rabban gamliel savar: potchin bacharata. mikar nidra bainan, uvae ayyone, ahachi yashav. verav nachman savar: en potchin bacharata, vaafillu meummad.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: chazi mar hay merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar: izdekiku leh rabbanan livreh derav huna bar avin, ushero leh nidreh vaamaru leh: zil uvei rachame al nafshach dachatat. detane rav dimi achu derav safra: kol hannoder, af al pi shehu mekayyeymo — nikra chote. amar rav zevid: may kera — "vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet", ha lo chadalta — ikka chet.
Tanya: haomer leishto "kol nedarim shettiddori, i efshi shettiddori", "en ze neder" — lo amar kelum. "yafe asit", veen kemotech", veim lo nadart, maddirech ani" — devarav kayyaymin.

Lo yomar adam leishto beshabbat "mufar lichi", "batel lichi", kederech sheomer lah bachol, ella omer lah: "teli veichli", "teli usheti", vehanneder batel meelav. amar rabbi yochanan: vetzarich sheyyevattel belibbo.
Tanya, bet shammay omrim: bashshabbat mevattel belibbo, bachol motzi bisfatav. uvet hillel omrim: echad ze veechad ze — mevattel belibbo, veen tzarich lehotzi bisfatav.
Amar rabbi yochanan: chacham sheamar bilshon baal, uvaal sheamar bilshon chacham — la amar kelum.
Detanya: "ze haddavar" — hechacham mattir veen baal mattir. sheyyachol: uma chacham sheen mefer — mattir, baal shemmefer — eno din shemmattir? talmud lomar:

a: "Ze haddavar" — chacham mattir, veen baal mattir. tanya iddach: "ze haddavar" — baal mefer veen chacham mefer. sheyyachol: uma baal sheen mattir — mefer, chacham shemmattir — eno din shemmefer, talmud lomar: "ze haddavar" — baal mefer, veen chacham mefer.

Neemar kan "ze haddavar", veneemar lehallan "ze haddavar" bishchute chutz. ma bishchute chutz — aharon uvanav vechol yisrael, af parashat nedarim — aharon uvanav vechol yisrael. uma kan rashe hammattot — af lehallan rashe hammattot.
Befarashat nedarim lemay hilcheta? amar rav acha bar yaakov: lehacheshir shelosha hedyotot. veha "rashe hammattot" ketiv! amar rav chisda veittema rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche.
Rashe hammattot bishchute chutz lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lomar sheyyesh sheela behekdesh.
Levet shammay deamar en sheela behekdesh, "rashe hammattot" dichtiv bishchute chutz lemay hilcheta? bet shammay let lehu gezera shava.
"Ze haddavar" befarashat nedarim lemay ketiv? lomar: chacham mattir veen baal mattir, baal mefer veen chacham mefer.
"Ze haddavar" bishchute chutz lemay ketiv? lomar: al hashshechita chayyayv, veen chayyayv al hammelika.
Ella levet shammay, lehacheshir shelosha hedyotot menalan? nafka lehu midderav assi bar natan.

Dichtiv: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael", vehatanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "moade" neemru, velo neemra shabbat bereshit immahen. ben azzay omer: "moade" neemru, velo neemar parashat nedarim immahen.
Rav assi bar natan kashya leh ha matnita. ata linhardea lekammeh derav sheshet vela ashkecheh, ata abbatreh lemachoza. amar leh: moade Adonai neemru, velo neemra shabbat bereshit immahen?
Veha ketiv shabbat immahen! vetu: moade Adonai neemru, velo neemra parashat nedarim immahen? veha missitra ketiva! amar leh, hachi katane:
b: Moade Adonai tzerichin kiddush bet din, shabbat bereshit en tzericha kiddush bet din.
Moade Adonai tzerichin mumeche, veen parashat nedarim tzerichin mumeche, afillu bet din hedyotot.
Veha befarashat nedarim "rashe hammattot" ketiv! amar rav chisda veittema rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche.

Amar rabbi chanina: hashshotek al menat lemekat, mefer afillu mikkan vead asara yamim. metiv rava: ematay amru met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav — bizman shello shama habbaal, o sheshshama veshatak, o sheshshama vehefer umet bo bayyom. aval shama vekiyyem, o sheshshama veshatak umet bayyom shel acharav — en yachol lehafer.
May lav, beshotek al menat lemekat? lo, beshotek al menat lekayyem. i hachi, hayeynu o shama vekiyyem! ella, beshotek setam.
Metiv rav chisda: chomer behakem mibbehafer, uvehafer mibbehakem. chomer behakem —

a: Shehashshetika mekayyemet, veen shetika mevattelet. kiyyem belibbo — kayyaym, hefer belibbo — eno mufar. kiyyem — en yachol lehafer, hefer — en yachol lekayyem. katane: shehashshetika mekayyemet, may lav beshotek al menat lemekat?
Lo, beshotek al menat lekayyem. hayeynu: kiyyem belibbo kayyaym! ella beshotek setam.
Ashkechan chomer behakem mibbehafer, behafer mibbehakem mena lan? amar rabbi yochanan: nishalin al hehakem, veen nishalin al hehafer.
Metiv rav kahana: "veim hacharesh yacharish lah ishah vegomer", beshotek al menat lemekat hakkatuv medabbar. atta omer beshotek al menat lemekat, o eno ella beshotek al menat lekayyem?
Keshehu omer "ki hecherish lah", hare beshotek al menat lekayyem hakkatuv medabber, ha ma ani mekayyem "im hacharesh yacharish lah ishah" — beshotek al menat lemekat hakkatuv medabber! teyuveta.
Velokem: ha — beshotek al menat lekayyem, ha — beshotek setam! kerae yattiri ketivi.
Metiv rava: nadra im chashecha — mefer lah ad shello chashcha, sheim lo hefer vechashcha — eno yachol lehafer. ammay? leheve keshotek al menat lemekat! teyuveta.
Metiv rav ashe: "yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim, aval eni yodea sheyyesh mefirin" — yafer. "yodea ani sheyyesh mefirin, aval eni yodea shezze neder", rabbi meir omer: lo yafer, vachachamim omrim: yafer.
Veammay? leheve keshotek al menat lemekat! teyuveta.
Hadran alach naara hameorasa
Veellu nedarim shehu mefer: devarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh: "im erchatz" veim lo erchatz", "im etkashshet" veim lo etkashshet".
b: Amar rabbi yose: en ellu nidre innuy nefesh. veellu hen nidre innuy nefesh: amra "kuvnnam perot haolam alay" — hare ze yachol lehafer. "perot medina zo alay" — yavi lah mimmedina acheret. "perot chenvoni ze alay" — eno yachol lehafer. veim lo hayta parnasato ella mimmennu — hare ze yafer, divre rabbi yose.
Gemara nidre innuy nefesh hu demefer, sheen bahen innuy nefesh eno mefer? veha tanya: "ben ish leishto ben av levitto" — melammed shehabbaal mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah!

Amri: halen vehalen mefer, mihu innuy nefesh — mefer leolam. aval en bahen innuy nefesh, kidita techoteh — havya hafara, mikki megaresh la — chayel ala nidra. bidvarim shebbeno levenah sheen bahen innuy nefesh. aval yesh bahen innuy nefesh — la chayel alay nidra.

Udevarim sheen bahen innuy nefesh, ki megaresh la chayyla ala? veha tenan, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: yafer, shemma yegarshenna utehe asura lo. alma: ki megaresh la umefar la meikkara — havya hafara!

Amri: halen vehalen havya hafara. ella: nidre innuy nefesh mefer, ben leatzmo uven laacherim. en bahen innuy nefesh, leatzmo — mefer, laacherim — eno mefer. vehachi katane: ellu nedarim shehu mefer ben leatzmo uven laacherim — nedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh.
"Im erchatz", hechi kaamar? illema deamra "kuvnnam perot olam alay im erchatz" — lema le hafara? la tirchatz vela littasran perot olam ellu ala!
Veod: beha lema rabbi yose en ellu nidre innuy nefesh? dilma rachatza veittasru perot olam ala.

a: Veella: deamra "kuvnnam hanaat rechitza alay leolam im erchatz", mishshum hachi mefer lah. dehechi taaved? tirchatz — mittasra hanaat rechitza ala, la tirchatz it la niuula. verabbi yose savar: efshar dela rachatza, uleniuul la chayyshinan.
I hachi, litne hachi, rabbi yose omer: tenay ze en bo innuy nefesh!
Ella deamra: "hanaat rechitza alay leolam im erchatz hayyom". verabbi yose savar: niuul dechad yoma la shemeh niuul.
b: Shannet "im erchatz". "im lo erchatz" hechi dame? illema deamra: "tittesar hanaat rechitza leolam alay im lo erchatz hayyom" — lema lah hafara? titseche! amar rav yehuda: deamra "hanaat rechitza alay leolam im lo erchatz beme mishra".
Dichvoteh dekatane "im lo etkashshet" — im lo etkashshet beneft. lichluch hu!
Amar [rav yehuda], deamra: "hanaat rechitza leolam alay im erchatz hayyom, ushevua shello erchatz", "hanaat kishshut alay leolam im etkashshet hayyom, ushevua shello etkashshet".

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hay "ellu nedarim ushevuot" mibbee leh lemitne! amar leh, teni: ellu nedarim ushevuot. veibbaet ema: shevuot name hayeynu nedarim. ditnan: "kenidre reshaim" — nadar benazir uvekorban uvishvua.

Vaamaru rabbanan: rechitza it ba innuy nefesh ki la rachatza? ureminhi: af al pi sheasur bechullan — en anush karet ella beochel veshote veose melacha bilvad. vei amrat ki la rachatza ikka innuy, beyom hakkippurim ki rachatz lichayyayv karet!

Amar rava: meinyana dikra. gabbe yom hakkippurim dichtiv "teannu et nafshotechem" — milleta deyada innuya hasheta. rechitza la yada innuya hasheta. gabbe nedarim dichtiv "kol neder vechol shevuat issar leannot nafesh" — milleta deatya leh lide innuy, vechi la rachatza atya lide innuy.

Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose: mayayn shel bene hair, chayyehen vechayye acherim — chayyehen kodmin lechayye acherim. behemtam [uvehemat acherim — behemtam] kodemet levehemat acherim. kevisatan uchevisat acherim — kevisatan kodemet lichvisat acherim. chayye acherim uchevisatan — chayye acherim kodmin lichvisatan.
Rabbi yose omer: kevisatan kodemet lechayye acherim. hasheta kevisa amar rabbi yose yesh bah tzaar,

a: Guf kullo lo kol shekken?! amri: in, kevisa allima lerabbi yose. deamar shemuel: hay arbuvita deresha — matya lide avira, arbuvita demane — matya lide shamumita, arbuvita degufa — matya lide shichne vechive.
Shelachu mittam: hizzaharu bearbuvita. hizzaharu bachavura. hizzaharu bivne aniyyim, shemmehen tetze tora, shenneemar: "yizzal mayim middallav", shemmehen tetze tora.

Umippene ma en metzuyin talmide chachamim latzet talmide chachamim mibbenehen? amar rav yosef, shello yomru: tora yerushsha hi lahem. rav sheshet bereh derav idi omer: kede shello yitgadderu al hatztzibbur. mar zutera omer: mippene shehen mitgabberin al hatztzibbur. rav ashe omer: mishshum dekaru leinashe "chamare".
Ravina omer: sheen mevarchin battora techilla. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv: "mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot" — davar ze nishal lachachamim velanneviim velo pershuhu,

Ad sheppersho hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai al ozvam et torati vegomer". hayeynu "lo shamu bekoli", hayeynu "lo halchu bah"! amar rav yehuda amar rav: sheen mevarchin battora techilla.

Isi bar yehuda la ata limtivta derabbi yose telata yome. ashkecheh vardimos berabbi yose, amar leh: may tama la ate mar leve midresha deabba ha telata yomin? amar leh: ki tameh daavuch la yadana, hecha etay? amar leh: lema mar may kaamar leh, dilma yadana tameh. amar leh: ha detanya, rabbi yose omer: kevisatan kodmin lechayye acherim, kera menalan?

Amar leh, dichtiv: "umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam vegomer". may "chayyaytam"? illema chayya — vahalo chayya bichlal behema hi. ella may "chayyaytam" — chayyuta mammash. peshita! ella lav kevisa, deha ikka tzara dearbuvita.

Amar rabbi yose: en ellu nidre innuy nefesh. ibbaya lehu: lerabbi yose, mahu sheyyafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah? ta shema, amar rabbi yose: en ellu nidre innuy nefesh. aval devarim shebbeno levenah havayin.
Dilma ledidhu kaamar lehu. ledidi afillu devarim shebbeno levenah la havayin. ledidchu, deamritu havayin nidre innuy nefesh — odo li deen ellu nidre innuy nefesh.
May? rav adda bar ahava omer: mefer, rav huna omer: en mefer,
b: Shello matzinu shual shemmet baafar pir.

Tanya kevoteh derav adda bar ahava: devarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh — mefer, ben beno levenah, ben benah leven acherim. sheen bahen innuy nefesh beno levenah — mefer. benah leven acherim — eno mefer. ketzad? amra "kuvnnam perot alay" — hare ze yafer. "kuvnnam sheeni osa lefi abba", "lefi achicha", "lefi avicha", "lefi achi", veshello etten teven lifne behemtecha umayim lifne bekarecha" — en yachol lehafer.
"Shello echchol", "shello efkos", veshello ashammesh mittati" — yafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah.
"Shello atztzia lach mittatecha", veshello emzog lecha et hakkos", veshello erchatz lach panecha yadecha veraglecha" — en tzarich lehafer.
Rabban gamliel omer: yafer, shenneemar: "lo yachel devaro". davar acher: "lo yachel devaro" — mikkan lechacham sheen mattir nidre atzmo.
Man shaminan deamar "shello echchol veshello efkos" devarim shebbeno levenah havayin — rabbi yose, vekatane demefar mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah.

Amar mar: "veshello ashammesh mittati" — yafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah. hechi dame? illema deamra: "hanaat tashmishi alecha", lema li hafara? ha meshuebedet leh! ella beomeret "hanaat tashmishcha alay", vechidrav kahana,
Deamar rav kahana: "hanaat tashmishi alecha" — kofah umeshammashto. "hanaat tashmishcha alay" — yafer, sheen maachilin et haadam davar haasur lo.

Man tena ha detanya: devarim hammuttarim vaacherim nahagu bahen issur — i atta rashshay linhog bahem hetter kede levattelan, mishshum shenneemar "lo yachel devaro", davar acher: "lo yachel devaro" — mikkan letalmid chacham sheen mefer nidre atzmo. manni? rabban gamliel hi.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: tashmish hammitta lerabbanan, innuy nefesh hu, o devarim shebbeno levenah? amar leh: tenetuha, "unetula ani min hayyehudim",

a: Yafer chelko, umeshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim. vei amrat neder innuy nefesh have, ammay tehe netula min hayyehudim? shema minna devarim shebbeno levenah havayin.

Lerabbanan tibbee lach, mishshum dintula ani min hayyehudim" rabbi yose katane la, deamar rav huna: kulleh pirkin rabbi yose hi. mimmay — kevan dekatane: rabbi yose omer en ellu nidre innuy nefesh, lema leh tu lemitne "hare ze yafer, divre rabbi yose"? shema minna: mikkan veelach rabbi yose hi.
Amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi: kol nedarim baal mefer leishto, chutz min "hanaati al peloni", sheeno mefer. aval "hanaat peloni alay" — mefer.
Tenan: "perot medina zo alay" — yavi lah mimmedina acheret, amar rav yosef: dekaamra shettavi.
Ta shema: "perot chenvani ze alay" — en yachol lehafer. hacha name deka amra shettavi atta.
Lo hayta parnasato ella mimmennu — hare ze yafer. vei amrat deka amra shettavi atta", ammay yafer? ella middesefa dela mayyte baal have, resha deka mayyta hi!
Ella: resha en yachol lehafer, udeka mayyta hi.
b: Umatnitin rabbi yose hi. deamar rav huna: kulleh pirkin rabbi yose hi. umay "en yachol lehafer", mishshum innuy nefesh, aval mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: nadra mishte chikkarot, beachat mitanna, uveachat en mitanna, mittoch shehu mefer lammitanna — mefer lesheeno mitanna. verav assi amar rabbi yochanan: mefer lammitanna, veen mefer lesheen mitanna.
Veikka deamri, bea minneh rav assi merabbi yochanan: nadra mishte chikkarot, beachat mitanna uveachat en mitanna, mahu? amar leh: mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna.
Etiveh: haishsha shennadra benazir, vehayta shote yayin, umittammea lemetim

a: Hare zo sofeget et haarbaim. hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah, vehayta shota yayin umittammeah lemetim — enah sofeget et haarbaim.
Vei amrat mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna, dilma min yayin deit la tzaara — hefer lah, min chartzan umin zag — lo hefer lah, deha la it la tzaara. vetispog et haarbaim!
Amar rav yosef: en nezirut lachatzain.
Amar leh abbaye: ha korban lachatzi nezirut ikka?! ella amar abbaye: en nezirut lachatzain, veen korban lachatzain.
Metivi: haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah — mevia chattat haof, veenah mevia olat haof. vei amrat en korban lachatzi nezirut, ammay mevia chattat haof?
Veella may — yesh korban lachatzi nezirut? shalosh behemot bae leetoye: chattat, ola, ushelamim! ella, leolam en korban lachatzi nezirut. vechattat haof dematya — mishshum dechattat al hassafek.
Etiveh: haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet, veachar kach hefer lah balah — mevia chattat haof, veen mevia olat haof. vei amrat mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna,
b: Dilma miyyayin deit la tzaara — hefer lah, mittumeat met, delet la tzaara — lo hefer lah?

Amri: mittumeat met name it la tzaara — dichtiv: "vehachay yitten el libbo", vetanya, haya rabbi meir omer: may dichtiv "vehachay yitten el libbo", deyispod — yispedun leh, deyivkun — yivkun leh, deyikbar — yikberuneh.
Mishna "kuvnnam sheani nehene labberiyyot" — eno yachol lehafer, vichola hi lehanot beleket, shichcha, uvefea.
"Kuvnnam kohanim leviyyim nehenim li" — yittelu al korcho. "kohanim ellu uleviyyim ellu nehenim li" — yittelu acherim.
Gemara alma efshar demittazna middileh, mikkelal devaal lav bichlal "beriyyot" hu. ema sefa: yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea, aval middevaal la achla, alma baal bichlal "beriyyot" hu!
Amar ulla: leolam lav bichlal "beriyyot" hu, veod: en yachol lehafer — mippene sheyyechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea.
Rava amar: leolam baal bichlal "beriyyot" hu, uma taam" kaamar: ma taam en yachol lehafer? mippene sheyyechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea.
Rav nachman amar: leolam baal lav bichlal "beriyyot" hu. vehachi katane: nitgarsha, yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea.

a: Etiveh rava lerav nachman: uvaal lav bichlal beriyyot hu? vehatnan: "netula ani min hayyehudim" — yafer chelko, utehe meshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim.
Vei amrat baal lav bichlal "beriyyot" hu, nidre innuy nefesh hen, veyafer lah leolam!
Ema lach: shane hacha, demochcha milleta deal hettera kaasra nafsha.
Yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea. vela katane uvemasar ani. vehatanya bevarayyta: uvemasar ani!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya ha — rabbi eliezer, ha — rabbanan. ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: en adam tzarich likrot shem al masar ani shel demay.
b: Vachachamim omrim: kore shem, veen tzarich lehaferish. may lav, leman deamar sefeko tovel, kasavar: it leh tovat hanaa, vechevan deit leh tovat hanaa — la mahneya.
Uleman deamar [eno] kore shem, kasavar: sefeko eno tovel, vechol shessefeko eno tovel — let leh tovat hanaa, ushere leh leithanoye.

Amar leh abbaye: dechulle alma sefeko tovel, verabbi eliezer verabbanan beha kamippalgi. rabbi eliezer savar: lo nechshedu amme haaretz al masar ani. kevan deillu mafkar nichseh vehave ani veshakel leh hu — let leh peseda.
Verabbanan savri: nichseh la mafkar inish, demirtat dilma zache behu inish acharina. hilkach — nechshedu.
Rava omer: kan bemasar ani hammitchallek betoch habbayit, dichtiva beh netina: "venatatta lallevi lagger vegomer" — mishshum hachi asur leh leithanoye.
Kan bemasar ani hammitchallek betoch haggoranot. kevan dichtiv beh "vehinnachta bisharecha", shere leh leithanoye.
Kohanim uleviyyim nehenin li yittelu kulei. alma tovat hanaa enah mamon.
Ema sefa: "kohanim ellu uleviyyim ellu nehenin li" — yittelu acherim, aval lehane — la. alma tovat hanaa mamon!

Amar rav hoshaya: la kashya, ha rabbi, veha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. detanya: haggonev tivlo shel chavero vaachalo — meshallem lo deme tivlo, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: eno meshallem ella deme chullin shebbo. may lav beha kamippalgi,

a: Derabbi savar: tovat hanaa mamon, verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar: tovat hanaa enah mamon?
La, dechulle alma tovat hanaa enah mamon. ella hacha bemattanot shello huremu ka mippalgi.
Vei tovat hanaa enah mamon — ma li huremu, ma li lo huremu?
Ella, hayeynu tama derabbi: kansu rabbanan legannav ki hechi dela lignov. verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar: kansu rabbanan levaal habbayit, ki hechi dela lishahe letivleh.
Rava amar: shane teruma, dehayynu tama deyittelu al korcho — mishshum ditruma la chazya ella lechohanim, vechevan deka ate lemesra alayyhu, shavveya afra bealma.
Mishna "kuvnnam sheeni osa al pi abba", veal pi avicha", veal pi achi", veal pi achicha" — eno yachol lehafer. "sheeni osa al picha" — eno tzarich lehafer.
Rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yoter min harauy lo.
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: yafer, shemma yegarshenna utehi asura alav.
Gemara amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri. lememra dekasavar shemuel adam makdish davar shello ba leolam? ureminhi: hammakdish maase yede ishto —
b: Hare zo osa veochelet. vehammotar — rabbi meir omer: hekdesh, rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: chullin. veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan hassandelar. alma en adam makdish davar shello ba leolam.
Vechi tema: ki kaamar halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri — al haadafa hu dekaamar.
Lema: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri behaadafa. i name: halacha ketanna kamma. i name: (en) halacha kerabbi akiva!
Ella amar rav yosef: shane kunnamot, hoil veadam oser perot chavero alav, oser name davar shello ba leolam alav.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama adam oser perot chavero alav, shehare adam oser perotav al chavero. ella yeesor davar shello ba leolam al chavero, shehare en adam oser perot chavero al chavero!
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: beomeret "yikdeshu yaday leosehen", deyadayim ha itanhu baolam.
Vechi amra hachi — kadsha? veha meshabedan yeday levaal! deamra: lechi miggarsha. hasheta mihat la miggarsha, umimmay dechi amra hachi mahneya?

a: Amar rabbi ila: uma illu omer lachavero "sade zo sheani mocher lecha, lichsheekkachenna mimmecha — tikkadesh", mi la kadsha?

Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: mi dame? "sade zo sheani mocher lecha" — hasheta bideh hi. ishsha, beyadah lehakedish maase yadeha?! ha la dame ella laomer lachavero "sade zo shemmacharti lecha, lichsheekkachenna mimmecha — tikkadesh", mi kadsha?

Matkef la rav pappa: mi dame?! gabbe zevina — pesika milletayyhu. gabbe ishsha mi pesika milleta? ha la dame ella laomer lachavero "sade zo shemmishkanti lecha, lichsheefdenna mimmecha — tikkadesh", mi la kadsha?

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: mi dame? sade beyado lifdoto. ishsha beyadah lehitgaresh?! ha la damya ella laomer lachavero "sade zo shemmishkanti lecha leeser shanim, lichsheefdenna mimmecha — tikkadesh", mi la kadsha?
Matkef la rav ashe: mi dame?! hatam kitz. ishsha mi it la kitztzuta?
b: Ella amar rav ashe: shane kunnamot, dechi kedushshat hagguf dame, vechidrava.
Deamar rava: hekdesh, chametz veshichrur — mafkiin mide shibud.
I hachi lema li shemma yegarshenna? teni: veod shemma yegarshenna.

Mishna nadra ishto vesavur shennadra bitto, nadra bitto vesavur shennadra ishto, nadra benazir vesavur shennadra bekorban, nadra bekorban vesavur shennadra benazir, nadra mitteenim vesavur shennadra min haanavim, nadra min haanavim vesavur shennadra min hatteenim — hare ze yachzor veyafer.
Gemara lememra deyani otah" davka hu?

a: Veha gabbe keraim dichtiv "al" "al", dichtiv: "al shaul veal yehonatan beno".
Vetanya: amru lo "met aviv" vekara, veachar kach nimtza beno — yatza yede keria.
Amri, la kashya: ha bistam, veha bimfaresh.
Vehatanya: amru lo "met aviv" vekara, veachar kach nimtza beno — lo yatza yede keria. amru lo "met lo met", uchesavur aviv hu vekara, veachar kach nimtza beno — yatza yede keria.
Rav ashe amar: kan betoch kede dibbur, kan leachar kede dibbur.
Ha dekaamrat yatza yede keria — shennimtza beno betoch kede dibbur. ha deamrat lo yatza yede keria — leachar kede dibbur.

Vehatanya: mi sheyyesh lo chole betoch beto venitallef, vechimdumme shemmet, vekara, veachar kach met — lo yatza yede keria. amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: lo shanu ella shemmet leachar kede dibbur, aval betoch kede dibbur — kedibbur dame.
Vehilcheta: toch kede dibbur — kedibbur dame, chutz mimmegaddef veoved avoda zara umekaddesh umegaresh.

Mishna amra "kuvnnam teenim vaanavim ellu sheani toemet", kiyyem litenim — kullo kayyaym, hefer litenim — eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim. amra "kuvnnam teena sheani toemet vaanava sheani toemet" — hare ellu shene nedarim.
Gemara manni matnitin? rabbi yishmael, detanya: "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", amra "kuvnnam teenim vaanavim ellu sheani toemet", kiyyem litenim — kullo kayyaym,
b: Hefer litenim — eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: hare hu omer "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", ma "yekimennu" — mimmennu, af "yeferennu" — mimmennu. verabbi yishmael: mi ketiv "yafer mimmennu"? verabbi akiva: makkish hafara lahakama, ma hakama — mimmennu, af hafara — mimmennu.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: makkish hakama lahafara; ma hafara — ma shehefer hefer, af hakama — ma shekkiyyem kiyyem.
Amra "kuvnnam teena", amar rava: matnitin rabbi shimon hi. deamar: ad sheyyomar "shevua" lechol echad veechad.
Mishna "yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim, aval eni yodea sheyyesh mefirin", yafer. "yodea ani sheyyesh mefirin, aval eni yodea shezze neder", rabbi meir omer: lo yafer, vachachamim omrim: yafer.
Gemara ureminhu: "belo reot", perat lassome. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: lerabbot et hassome.

a: Amar rava: hacha meinyaneh dikra vehacha meinyaneh dikra. rabbi yehuda savar: gabbe rotzeach ketiv "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar" — kol devar meal leyaar, vessome name bar meal leyaar hu. vei amrat "belo reot" lerabbot et hassome — miyyaar" nafka leh. ella shema minna: "belo reot" perat lessome.
Rabbi meir savar: ketiv "bivli daat" — kol devar midda, vessome lav bar midda hu. vei amrat "belo reot" perat lassome — mibbeli daat" nafka leh. ella shema minna: "belo reot" lerabbot et hassome.
Mishna hammaddir hanaa mechatano, vehu rotze latet levitto maot, omer lah: hare hammaot haellu netunin lach bemattana, uvilvad shello yehe levalich reshut bahen, ella ma sheat noset venotenet befich.

Gemara amar rav: lo shanu ella deamar la "ma sheat noset venotenet befich", aval amar "ma shettirtzi asi", kena yathon baal. ushemuel omer: afillu amar "ma shettirtzi asi" — la kena yathon baal. matkef la rabbi zera:
b: Keman azla ha shemata derav — kerabbi meir, deamar: yad ishsha keyad balah.
Ureminhu: ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy? manniach et hechavit veomer: hare ze lechol bene mavoy. umezakke lahen al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim, veal yede beno uvitto haggedolim, veal yede ishto.
Vei amrat kena yathon bala, eruv la nafek mershuteh devaal!
Amar rava: af al gav deamar rabbi meir yad ishsha keyad balah, mode rabbi meir leinyan shittuf, dechevan dilzakkot laacherim hu miyyad balah — zachya.

Etiveh ravina lerav ashe: ellu shezzachin lahen: [al yede] beno uvitto haggedolim, veavdo veshifchato haivrim. veellu sheen zachin lahen: al yede beno uvitto hakketannim, veavdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, veishto!
Ella amar rav ashe: matnitin besheyyesh lah chatzer beoto mavoy askinan, demiggo dezachya lenafsha — zachya leacharine.
Mishna "veneder almana ugerushah yakum aleha", ketzad? amra "hareni nezira leachar sheloshim yom", af al pi shennisset betoch sheloshim yom — eno yachol lehafer.

a: Nadra vehi birshut habbaal — mefer lah. ketzad? amra "hareni nezira leachar sheloshim", af al pi shennitalmena o nitgarsha betoch sheloshim — hare ze mufar. nadra bo bayyom venitgarsha bo bayyom, hechzira bo beyom — eno yachol lehafer. ze hakkelal: kol sheyyatza lirshut atzmah shaa achat — eno yachol lehafer.

Gemara tanya: almana ugerusha sheamra "hareni nezira lichsheinnase" venisset, rabbi yishmael omer: yafer, verabbi akiva omer: lo yafer. vesimana: yeleli. eshet ish sheamra "hareni nezira lichsheetgaresh" venitgarsha, rabbi yishmael omer: lo yafer, verabbi akiva omer: yafer.

Amar rabbi yishmael: hare hu omer "veneder almana ugerusha vegomer", ad sheyyehe neder bishat almanut vegerushin. rabbi akiva savar: hare hu omer "kol asher asra al nafshah", ad sheyyehe issure neder bishat almanut vegerushin.
Amar rav chisda: matnitin — rabbi akiva hi. abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi yishmael, matnitin talya nafsha beyome, barayyta talya nafsha benissuin.
Shalmu yome vela nitgarsha, shalmu yome vela mitnasva.
"Ze hakkelal" dekatane gabbe "naara hameorasa" — leetoye halach haav im sheluche habbaal o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal, benaara hameorasa, deaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha.
"Ze hakkelal" dekatane gabbe "veellu nedarim", leetoye masar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, sheen habbaal mefer bakkodmin.
Mishna tesha nearot nidrehen kayyaymin: bogeret vehi yetoma. naara uvagra vehi yetoma.
b: Naara shello bagra vehi yetoma. bogeret umet aviha. naara bogeret umet aviha. naara shello bagra umet aviha. naara shemmet aviha umishshemmet aviha bagra. bogeret veaviha kayyaym. naara bogeret veaviha kayyaym. rabbi yehuda omer: af hammassi bitto hakketanna venitalmena o nitgarsha vechazra etzlo — adayin hi naara.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi yehuda. aval chachamim omrim, shalosh nearot nidrehen kayyaymin: bogeret, vitoma, vitoma bechayye haav.
Mishna "kuvnnam sheeni nehene leabba uleavicha im osa ani al picha", "sheeni nehenet lecha im osa ani al pi abba veal pi avicha" — hare ze yafer.
Gemara tanya: "sheeni nehenet leabba uleavich im ani osa leficha", rabbi natan omer: lo yafer. vachachamim omrim: yafer.
"Netula ani min hayyehudim im meshammashtecha", rabbi natan omer: lo yafer. vachachamim omrim: yafer.
Hahu gavra deittesar hanayayta dealma aleh i nasev itteta ki la tanena hilcheta. rahet begappa vetuvalya vela immetzi lemitne. ata rav acha bar rav huna veshabbesheh veinnesiv itteta,

a: Vesharkeh tina, veatyeh lekammeh derav chisda. amar rava: man chakkim lemibad ki ha milleta i lav derav acha bar rav huna, degavra rabba hu. dekasavar dechi hechi difligi rabbanan verabbi natan bahafara — hachi name peligi bishela.

Verav pappi amar: machaloket bahafara, derabbi natan savar: en habbaal mefer ella im ken chal neder, dichtiv: "vechafra hallevana". verabbanan savri: baal mefer af al pi shello chal neder, dichtiv: "mefer machshevot arumim".
Aval bishela — divre hakkol en chacham mattir kelum ella im ken chal neder, dichtiv: "lo yachel devaro".

Lema mesayyay leh: "kuvnnam sheeni nehene lifloni, ulemi sheeshshael alav" — nishal al harishon, veachar kach nishal al hashsheni. vei amrat nishal af al pi shello chal neder, i bae — al hay nitteshil beresha, i bae — al hay nitteshil beresha.
Umi yada i hay kamma i hay batra?
Ella lema mesayyay leh: "kuvnnam sheeni nehene lifloni, hareni nazir lichsheeshshael alav" — nishal al nidro, veachar kach nishal al nizro.
Vei amrat nishal af al pi shello chal neder, i bae — al nidro itteshil beresha, i bae — al nizro itteshil beresha! rabbi natan hi.
Amar ravina: amar li marimar, hachi amar avuch mishshemeh derav pappi: machaloket bahafara, aval bishela — divre hakkol mefer veaf al pi shello chal neder, dichtiv "lo yachel devaro".
b: Lememra dela hava beh maase.
Metivi: "kuvnnam sheeni nehene lifloni ulemi shennishal alav" — nishal al harishon, veachar kach nishal al hashsheni. ammay? i bae — al hay nitteshil beresha, vei bae — al hay nitteshil beresha!
Mi yodea he rishon vehe sheni?

Metivi: "kuvnnam sheeni nehene vahareni nazir lichsheeshshael alav" — nishal al nidro, veachar kach nishal al nizro. veammay? i bae — al nidro nitteshil beresha, vei bae — al nizro nitteshil beresha! teyuveta.
Mishna barishona hayu omrim: shalosh nashim yotzot venotlot ketuva: haomeret "temea ani lach", "shamayim beni levenach", unetula ani min hayyehudim".

Chazru lomar, shello tehe ishsha notenet eneha beacher umekalkelet al balah: haomeret "temea ani lach" — tavi reaya lidvareha. "hashshamayim beni levenach" — yaasu derech bakkasha. unetula ani min hayyehudim" — yafer lechelko, utehe meshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: amra levalah "temea ani", mahu shettochal bitruma? rav sheshet amar: ochelet, shello totzi laaz al baneha. rava amar: enah ochelet, efshar deachla chullin.
Amar rava: umode rav sheshet sheim nitarmela sheenah ochelet. midde hu tama ella mishshum totzi laaz al baneha. nitarmela venitgarsha, amri: hasheta deittenisa.

Amar rav pappa, badek lan rava: eshet kohen shenneensa, yesh lah ketubba o en lah ketubba? kevan deones legabbe kohen keratzon legabbe yisrael dame, en lah ketubba. o dilma matze amra leh: ana ha chazena,

a: Vegavra hu denistachafa sadehu. veamrinan leh, matnitin hi: haomeret "temea ani lach" — yesh lah ketubba.

Bemay askinan? ilema beeshet yisrael, i beratzon — kelum yesh lah ketubba? vei beones — mi ka mittasra al gavra? veella beeshet kohen. i beratzon — kelum yesh lah ketubba? mi gara meeshet yisrael beratzon? ella lav: beones, vekatane: yesh lah ketubba.

Ibbaya lehu: amra levalah "gerashtani", mahu? amar rav hamenuna: ta shema: haomeret "temea ani lach", daafillu lemishna acharona dekatane la mehemna — hatam hu dimshakkera, deyada devala la yada bah. aval gabbe "gerashtani" deyada bah — mehemna, dachazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah.
Amar leh rava: adrabba, afillu lemishna rishona dekatane mehemna — hatam mishshum dela avida levazzoye nafsha, aval hacha dezimnin ditkif la min gavra — meizza umeizza.

Metiv rav mesharsheya: "hashshamayim beni levenach" demishna rishona — teyuveta derava, hacha delet la kissufa, vekatane dimhemna! kasavar rava: hatam, kevan dela saggi la dela amra "en yore kechetz", i la ita kidkaamra — la amra leh.
"Hashshamayim beni levenach" demishna acharona, tihve teyuveta derav hamenuna: veha hacha deyada hi, uvala yada ba, vekatane dela mehemna!
Kasavar rav hamenuna: hacha name hi gufa amra: nehi divvia yada, beyore kechetz mi yada? umishshum hachi meshakkera.
Hahi itteta dechol yoma detashmish mikaddema mashya yedeh legavra. yoma chad atya leh mayya lemimshe. amar la: hada milleta la havat haiddana! amara leh: im ken, chad min nochrim
b: Ahaloye dahavo hacha haiddana, i ant la — dilma minnehon. amar rav nachman: eneha natna beacher, velet ba meshasha bemilla.

Hahi itteta dela hava bedicha data bahade gavra. amar la: haiddana may shena? amara leh: meolam la tzaartan bederech eretz ki haiddana. amar la: la hava hada milleta haiddana. amara leh: im ken halen nochrim naftoye dahavo hacha haiddana, i ant la — dilma chad minnehon. amar lehu rav nachman: la tashgichun ba, notenet eneha beacher havay.
Hahu gavra dahava miharezik beveta hu veinteta. al ata mareh deveta, parteh noef lehutza vaarak. amar rava: itteta sharya. im ita daavad issura — irchose hava mirchas.

Hahu noef deal legabbe dehahi inteta, ata gavra, selek noef ittiv [bichlae] bava. hava machatan tachle tamman vetaminnun chivya. bea mare deveta lemechal min hanhu tachle bela data deinteta, amar leh hahu noef: la techul minnehon detaminnun chivya.
Amar rava: inteteh sharya, im iteh daavad issura, nicha leh delechol velemut, dichtiv: "ki niefu vedam bidehen".
Peshita! mahu detema: issura avad, vehay daamar leh denicha leh dela lemut baal, detehve inteteh illaveh "mayim genuvim yimtaku velechem setarim yinam", ka mashma lan.
Haderan alach veellu nedarim uselika la massechet nedarim

a: Kol kinnuye nezirut — kinzirut.
Haomer "ehe" — hare ze nazir, o "ehe nae" — nazir, "nazik", "naziach", "paziach" — hare ze nazir. "hareni kaze", "hareni mesalsel", "hareni mechalkel", "hare alay leshalleach pera" — hare ze nazir.
"Hare alay tzipporim" — rabbi meir omer: nazir. vachachamim omrim: eno nazir.
Gemara mikkede tanna beseder nashim kae, may tama tane nazir?
Tanna akkera kae: "vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav ki matza vah ervat davar". vehachi kaamar: mi garam lah laavera — yayin, vekaamar: kol haroe sota bekilkulah yazzir atzmo min hayyayin.
Patach bechinnuyin, umefaresh yadot.
Amar rava, veittema kedi: chassore michassera vehachi katane: kol kinnuye nezirut — kinzirut, vidot nezirut — kinzirut, veellu hen yadot: haomer "ehe" — hare ze nazir.
Velifrosh kinnuye beresha! tanna mehahu desalek — hahu mefaresh beresha. keditnan: bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin, umefaresh "en madlikin" beresha.
Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin, umefaresh "en tomnin" beresha.
Bamma ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza, umefaresh "lo tetze ishsha" beresha.
Vehatnan: bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza, umefaresh "yotze gamal" beresha.
Yesh nochalin umanchilin, nochalin velo manchilin, manchilin velo nochalin, lo nochalin velo manchilin, umefaresh "ellu nochalin umanchilin" beresha!
Ella, leolam tane hachi vetane hachi.
Ella: hatam, deissura denafsheh hu — mefaresh issura denafsheh beresha. gabbe behema, deissura ayyeyde behema hu deate — mefaresh hettera beresha.
b: Gabbe "yesh nochalin" name, mefaresh ikkar nachala beresha.
Ella [hacha] lifrosh kinnuye beresha! ella hayeynu taam: yadot, hoil veatyayn leh midderasha, chavivin leh.
Veliftach behon beresha! tanna ki matchil — matchil beikkar korban, uleinyan payrushe — mefaresh yadot beresha.
Haomer "ehe" — hare ze nazir. dilma "ehe betaanit" kaamar? amar shemuel: kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav.

Lema kasavar shemuel yadayim sheenan mochichot la havvyayn yadayim? amri: bizman shennazir over lefanav lekka lesappoke bemilleta acharina. aval vadday en hannazir over lefanav, amrinan: dilma "ehe betaanit" kaamar.
Vedilma lefotro min korbenotav kaamar? dekaamar belibbo.
I hachi, may lememra! mahu detema: bainan piv velibbo shavin, ka mashma lan.

"Ehe nae" — nazir. vedilma: ennae lefanav bemitzvot? kidtanya: "ze eli veanvehu" — ennae lefanav bemitzvot. eese lefanav sukka naa, lulav nae, tzitzit naa, echtov lefanav sefer tora nae veechrechennu beshirain naim!
Amar shemuel: shettafus bisaro, veamar "ennae".
Nezira milleta daavera, veamrinan leh "nae"?

a: In, daafillu lerabbi elazar hakkappar deamar: nazir chote, hane mille gabbe nazir tame, deayyeyde devae mistar, deamar rachamana: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro", hatam hu, dilma ate lemibar al neziruteh, aval nazir tahor — lav chote kare beh.
"Hareni kaze" — nehi name detafus bisaro, "hareni kaze" — la amar! amar shemuel: kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav.
"Hareni mesalsel" — mimmay dehaden silsul sara? kedaamara leh hahi ammeta deve rabbi lehahu gavra: ad matay atta mesalsel bisarcha?
Ema tora, dichtiv "salseleha uterommekka"? amar shemuel: hacha name shettafus bisaro.
"Hareni mechalkel" — mimmay dehaden kilkul searo hu? keditnan: sid, rabbi yehuda omer: kede lasud kilkul. veamar rav: bat tzida.
Ema mezan anye, kedichtiv: "vaychalkel yosef et aviv veet echav". amar shemuel: hacha name shettafus bisaro.
"Hare alay leshalleach pera" — hare ze nazir. mimmay dehaden shilluach ribbuya hu, dichtiv: "shelachayich pardes rimmonim".
Ema midde deabbore, kedichtiv: "vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot"!
Tanna "pera" "pera" yalef. ketiv hacha "kadosh yihye gaddel pera", uchetiv hatam gabbe kohen hedyot "ufera lo yeshallechu".
Veibbaet ema hay "sholeach mayim" name ribbuy hu, (kedimtargem rav yosef:) dechad mashkin leh mayya lefera verave.
"Hare alay tzipporin" — rabbi meir omer: nazir. may tama derabbi meir? amar resh lakish: tzipporin semuchin lesear kibbel alav, dichtiv "ad di sareh kenishrin reva vetifrohi chetzipperin".
Rabbi meir savar: matpes inish bemidde dismich leh.
b: Verabbanan savri: la matpes inish bemidde dismich leh.
Rabbi yochanan amar: dechulle alma la matpes. ella, hayeynu tama derabbi meir: dechayyshinan shemma tzippore nazir tame kibbel alav.
Mikkede "chayyshinan" kaamar, dilma tzippore nedava kibbel alav? im ken, "hare alay ken" mibbee leh.
Vedilma "hare alay tzippore metzora" kaamar? kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav. vedilma nazir tame, ulefotro min korbenotav kaamar?! kegon shehaya nazir tahor over lefanav.
May benayyhu?

Ikka benayyhu kegon deamar "tzipporin hassemuchin lesear alay", lerabbi yochanan, af al gav deamar hachi, i nazir over lefanav — in, i la — la. lerabbi shimon ben lakish, af al gav deen nazir over lefanav.

Mi ikka leman deamar la matpes inish bemilleta dismich leh? vehatanya: haomer "yamin" — hare zo shevua. may tama, lav mishshum dichtiv "vayyarem yemino usemolo el hashshamayim vayyishshava beche haolam"?
Amri: la, mishshum deyamin gufeh ikkeri shevua. detanya: minnayin laomer "yamin" shehi shevua, shenneemar: "nishba Adonai bimino", uminnayin laomer semol shehi shevua, shenneemar: "uvizroa uzzo".
Mishna "hareni nazir min hachartzannim" umin hazzaggim" umin hattiglachat" umin hattumea" — hare ze nazir, vechol dikduke nezirut alav.
Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: eno chayyayv ad sheyyiddor mikkullam. verabbanan amri: afillu la nezar ella bechad minnehon — have nazir.
May tama derabbi shimon — amar kera: "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin mechartzannim vead zag". verabbanan, may tama — amar kera: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir".
Verabbi shimon name, hachtiv: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir"! hahu mibbee leh — leesor yen mitzva keyen harshut.
May hi — kiddusheta veavdalta?

a: Hare musheba veomed alav mehar sinay!
Ella ki ha deamar rava "shevua sheeshte", vechazar veamar: "hareni nazir" — atya nezirut chayyla al shevua.
Verabbanan name, ha mibbee leh leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut! im ken, lema kera "miyyayin". may "veshechar"? shamat minna tarte.

Verabbi shimon, hayeynu tama dichtav "shechar" — leallofe "shechar" "shechar" lemikdash. dichtiv: "yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha ittach", ma gabbe nazir: yayin hu delittesar, aval shear mashkin — la, af gabbe mikdash name: yayin hu delittesar, aval shear mashkin hammishtakkerin — la.
Uleappoke midderabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: achal devela keilit, veshata devash vechalav, venichnas lammikdash — chayyayv.
Ibbaet ema: rabbi shimon let leh issur chal al issur.
Detanya, rabbi shimon omer: haochel nevela beyom hakkippurim — patur.
Ulerabbanan name, hachtiv: "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin"! amri lach rabbanan: hatam limmed al issure nazir shemmitztarfim ze im ze.
Verabbi shimon let leh tzeruf, detanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu lemakkot, lo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban.
Mishna "hareni keshimshon", "keven manoach", "kevaal delila", "kemi sheakar daltot azza", "kemi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav" — hare ze nezir shimshon.
Gemara lema li lemitna kol halen? tzerichi, dei amar "hareni keshimshon", hava amena: shimshon acharina, ka mashma lan "keven manoach".
Vei tena "keven manoach", hava amena: ikka demitkere hachi, ka mashma lan "kevaal delila" uchemi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav".
Mishna ma ben nezir olam lenazir shimshon? nezir olam, hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umevi shalosh behemot. veim nitma — mevi korban tumea.
Nezir shimshon, hichbid searo — eno mekel, veim nitma — eno mevi korban tumea.

Gemara nezir olam man dechar shemeh? chassore michassera vehachi katane: haomer "hareni nezir olam" — hare ze nazir. ma ben nezir olam linzir shimshon? nezir olam, hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umevi shalosh behemot, veim nitma — mevi korban tumea. nezir shimshon, hichbid searo — eno mekel betaar,
b: Veeno mevi korban tumea.
Korban hu dela mayyte, aval nezirut chayyla aleh.

Manni matnitin? la rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: nezir shimshon — muttar litamme lemetim, shekken matzinu beshimshon shennitma. rabbi shimon omer: haomer "nezir shimshon" — lo amar kelum, shello matzinu beshimshon sheyyatzat nezirut mippiv.
Manni? i rabbi yehuda — haamar afillu lechattechilla, umatnitin katane "im nitma". i rabbi shimon — haamar la chayyla aleh nezirut kelal!
Leolam rabbi yehuda hi, veayyeyde dekatane gabbe nezir olam "im nitma", tena name gabbe nezir shimshon "im nitma".
Lema biflugeta dehane tannae kamippalgi, ditnan: "hare alay kivchor", rabbi yaakov oser, verabbi yose mattir.
May lav, rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yaakov, deamar: la bainan davar hanniddar. verabbi shimon savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: bainan davar hanniddar?
La, dechulle alma bainan davar hanniddar, veshane gabbe bechor, dichtiv beh: "laAdonai" — lerabbot et habbechor.
Verabbi yose amar lach: hahu "laAdonai", mibbee leh lerabbot chattat veasham.
Uma raita lerabbot chattat veasham ulehotzi et habbechor? merabbe ani chattat veasham — shekken matpisan beneder, umotzi ani et habbechor — sheen matpiso beneder.
Verabbi yaakov amar lach: bechor name matpiso beneder hu. detanya: shel bet rabbenu amru: minnayin lenolad lo bechor betoch edro shemmitzva alav lehakedisho — shenneemar: "hazzachar takdish".
Verabbi yose amar lach: nehi demitzva lehakedisho, i la makdesh leh, mi la kadosh?
Gabbe nazir name, hachtiv "laAdonai"!

Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, amar shimon hatztzaddik: miyyamay lo achalti asham nazir tame, chutz meadam echad shebba elay min haddarom, yefe enayim vetov roi, ukevutztzotav sedurot lo taltallim. amarti lo: beni, ma raita leshachet sear nae ze?

Amar li: roe hayiti leavi beiri, vehalachti lishov mayim min hammayayn, venistakkalti babbavua shelli, ufachaz yitzri alay, uvikkesh letordeni min haolam. amarti lo: reka! mippene ma atta mitgae beolam sheeno shellecha, shessofcha lihyot rimma vetolea? haavoda sheagallechacha lashshamayim.
Amadti uneshaktiv al rosho, amarti lo: kemotcha yirbu nezirim beyisrael — alecha hakkatuv omer: "ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir laAdonai".
Veshimshon lav nazir hava? vehachtiv: "ki nezir elohim yihye hannaar min habbeten"! hatam malach hu dekaamar.
Umenalan deittammi lemetim? illema middichtiv "bilchi hachamor hikketi elef ish" — dilma garoye gari behu vela nega behu!
Ella mehacha: "vayyach mehem sheloshim ish vayyikkach et chalitzotam". dilma ashlechinnun beresha vahadar katlinnun? "vayyach ... vayyikkach" ketiv.
Vedilma gossin shavvinun! ella: gemara gemiri la.

Unezir olam hecha ketiv? detanya, rabbi omer: avshalom nezir olam haya, shenneemar: "vayhi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallem et nidri asher nadarti laAdonai bechevron", umegalleach echad lishnem asar chodesh, shenneemar: "vayhi mikketz yamim layyamim".

a: Veyalef "yamim" "yamim" mibbatte are choma. ma hatam shenem asar chodesh — af kan shenem asar chodesh.
Rabbi nehoray omer: megalleach achat lishloshim yom. rabbi yose omer: megalleach meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, shekken matzinu bivne melachim shemmegallechim meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.
May tama derabbi — yalef mibbatte are choma. veha rabbi hu deamar: en "yamim" pechutin mishshenayim!
Hay gezera shava mishshum koved gemir, uvishne yamim lekka koved.
Veema shete shanim, dichtiv: "vayhi mikketz shenatayim yamim"?! danin "yamim" sheen immahen shanim miyyamim" sheen immahen shanim, veal yochiach ze sheyyesh immo shanim.
Veema sheloshim yom, dichtiv: "ad chodesh yamim"! danin "yamim" sheen immahem chodashim miyyamim" sheen immahem chodashim, veal yochiach ze sheyyesh immo chodashim.
Veema mehacha: "miyyamim yamima vegomer", danin "yamim" miyyamim", veen danin "yamim" miyyamima".
Umay nafka minna, veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen", — zo hi shiva zo hi bia!
Hane mille hecha delekka dedame leh, aval hecha deikka dedame leh — middedame leh yalfinan.
Ikka deamri: mena yadinan dechol telata yarchin chad zimna? dilma arbea zimne beshatta, (i name) arbea yarchin chad zimna, teren yarchin bechad zimna!
Rabbi nehoray omer: megalleach achat lishloshim yom. may tama? gabbe chohanim mishshum deikka koved, hacha name ikka koved.
Rabbi yose omer: megalleach meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. may ikka beneh lishar achohi!
Yom tov shechal lihyot beemtza shabbat, daachohi megallechin, hu la megallach. i name: legalloche min tzafra demaale shabbeta, achohi megallechin, ihu la megallach ad panya.

Hane arbaim shana, may avidtayyhu? rabbi nehoray omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: leketz arbaim shana sheshshaalu lahen melech. tana: otah shana sheshshaalu lahen melech hi shenat eser lishmuel haramati.
Mishna setam nezirut sheloshim yom.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rav matna, amar kera: "kadosh yihye" — "yihye" begimatriyya telatin havu.
Bar peda amar: keneged "nazir" "nizro" haamurim battora, sheloshim chaser achat.
Verav matna name, nelaf minnazir" "nizro"!
Amar lach, hahu lidrasha: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir" — leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut, "ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir" — melammed shehannezirut chala al nezirut.
b: Uvar peda amar lach: lekka chad minnehon delav lidrasha? ella middehahu leminyayna, kullehu name leminyayna.
Tenan: setam nezirut sheloshim yom. bishlama lerav matna — nicha, ella levar peda — kashya!
Amar lach bar peda: ayyeyde deikka yom telatin dimgalleach umevi korbenotav, mishshum hachi tena sheloshim.
Tenan: mi sheamar "hareni nazir" — megalleach yom sheloshim veechad. bishlama lerav matna nicha, ella levar peda kashya!
Amar lach bar peda, ema sefa: im gillach leyom sheloshim — yatza. ella sefa mesayyeya leh, resha — naasa keomer "shelemin".
Ulerav matna kashya sefa! kasavar miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Tenan: "hareni nazir sheloshim yom", im gillach yom sheloshim — lo yatza! beomer "shelemin".
Tenan: mi shennazar shete nezirut — megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad, vehashsheniyya leyom shishshim veechad. bishlama lerav matna — nicha.
